theme: An open day at home, with room to clear what's been waiting.
greeting: Nothing's on the calendar today, Dan, and the girls are with you and Mike in St. Pete — a rare wide-open Friday. The quiet hours are the best window for the Brunswick reply and the Maine Christmas rental before the day fills in around the kids.

needsAttention.title: Send Brunswick your availability
needsAttention.detail: Erika Maass (recruiting) wrote Oct 29: Christian Buss wants another 30 minutes with you and she needs your availability for the coming week to set it up. Both earlier conversations went well, so this is the process advancing — it's waiting on you.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Your top-priority task, overdue since mid-September. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the thinnest, fastest-selling rental in that market. Book refundable now and adjust the dates later — holding it early costs nothing and removes the whole risk.
